plugin.name: Required — DD SN AddOn.esp (telord V1.1-beta)
plugin.description:
HARD REQUIREMENT. This zip does not bundle telord's addon.
Install DD_SkyrimNet_AddOn_V1.1-beta.zip by @telord first. In that FOMOD, tick Base so DD SN AddOn.esp is active. That DLL registers the vrtedd_* decorators this overlay reads (worn devices, gag name, blind, deaf, visible toys).
Discord drop: https://discord.com/channels/1287232260617015336/1541604450072793139/1543822052899815584
MO2 will warn if DD SN AddOn.esp is missing. Install the addon, enable the ESP, then run this installer again.
Also needs Devious Devices - Integration.esm (DD SE / DD NG).

plugin.name: Required — SkyrimNetUDNG.esp (naitro2010)
plugin.description:
HARD REQUIREMENT. This zip does not bundle naitro2010's plugin.
Install SkyrimNet_UDNG first. It ships SkyrimNetUDNG.esp and the DD NG lock/unlock Papyrus (ExtCmdEquip*/ExtCmdUnequip* by slot) that this overlay's BDSMLOCK drilldown calls, plus the SkyrimNetDDUDNG_Event mod-event gagged_speech listens for on lock/unlock.
Credit: naitro2010 — https://github.com/naitro2010/SkyrimNet_UDNG Releases: https://github.com/naitro2010/SkyrimNet_UDNG/releases
MCM: NPC can equip devices on the player = ON.
MO2 will warn if SkyrimNetUDNG.esp is missing. Install it, enable the ESP, then run this installer again.

plugin.name: UnforgivingDevices.esp detected: installing UDNG-patched vibrator scripts
plugin.description:
Not a choice — locked to whatever the installer actually finds. This box is checked and greyed out if `UnforgivingDevices.esp` (Unforgiving Devices NG by naitro2010 — the actual DD NG script patch mod, a different plugin from SkyrimNet_UDNG's own `SkyrimNetUDNG.esp`, which is already a hard requirement on the previous page) is active in your load order. Unchecked and greyed out if it isn't. Either way there is nothing to click here.
Checked: the seven vibrator actions (remote/BDSMLOCK press) call `zadLibs_UDPatch` instead of base `zadLibs`, so pressing the remote actually drives UDNG's own custom vibrator render scripts when she's wearing one of UDNG's custom devices — falls back to vanilla DD NG behavior on anything else, so it's safe on a mixed UDNG/vanilla-DD-NG game.
Unchecked: the actions keep calling base `zadLibs.VibrateEffectAsync` / `zadLibs.StopVibrating`. Nothing changes.
Credit for the compatible action definitions: naitro2010.

plugin.name: Medium — RP-focused
plugin.description:
Shops, quests, and kind followers stay on the job. A greeting is not a lock.
Predators, shady types, real arrests, and "she asked" still fire BDSMLOCK / strip / the remote. Occupancy, combat omit, and women-only are the same as Hard.
Pick this if you want roleplay that can go there without every NPC treating her as livestock.

plugin.name: Hard — being made a pet
plugin.description:
Locking an adult woman is ordinary manners in this Skyrim. They look, they talk, they fire the ACTION.
Same occupancy, same combat omit, same women-only rule as Medium. The difference is *when* — culture, not a bandit-after-fight special.
Pick this if the hold is already using her.

plugin.name: Experimental — arousal bands + follower remote
plugin.description:
Leave this OFF if you want lock/strip/vibe/ungag without horniness numbers in the prompt.
Turn it ON to add 0730 (a new file — it concatenates, it does not replace Hard/Medium):
• Arousal bands from sla_Arousal (SLO Aroused NG). 0 dry, 20–60 the play window, 70 already insane, 90–100 gone. After 60 it is too late to play it cool. Prints the number. Does not fire ArousalChange — SkyrimNet_Arousal owns that.
• Followers and friends may press the remote on their own if she is plugged, they are at least warming, and nobody is in combat. Prefer edge (teaseOnly).
• Ungag-to-feed if she is gagged and SunHelm thirst/hunger is ≥ 70 — same beat the AIO already has. Harmless overlap.
Without SLO, ranks read 0 and cold NPCs see nothing extra. Without SunHelm, thirst/hunger read 0 and the feed beat does not fire. Combat still omits the overlay. Not a world-setting rewrite. Not occupancy. Invent it — not a copy-me script.
Needs: SLO Aroused NG + SkyrimNet_Arousal for the numbers; SunHelm optional.

plugin.name: Open Features.md when you're done
plugin.description:
Installed. Features.md ships in this mod's own folder, right next to README.md — open it for the full player-facing rundown: gagged speech, arms-then-clothes, ungag-to-drink, the vibrator remote, women-only locking, and what Hard vs Medium actually change.
FOMOD can't launch a file for you — this page is the reminder, not a script. Find it after install at your MO2 mods folder \ Lyza's SkyrimNet_DDUDNG fixes \ Features.md, or right-click the mod in MO2's left pane -> Open in Explorer.
